structured_output.summary: The change implements getUint32 as the spec describes. It takes this as the view and defaults littleEndian to false when the argument is absent. It then returns the result of the shared get_view_value helper with ElementType::Uint32, propagating errors with no changes to them. The gate report shows the build and clippy passing, and the target going from 6 to 36 passing with no regressions. I did not open get_view_value itself, since it is outside the diff. The GetViewValue steps (RequireInternalSlot, ToIndex, bounds checks, GetValueFromBuffer) are assumed to live there. The only other edit is renaming new_target to _new_target to silence the unused-variable warning, which is harmless.
